answers.core:
This dramatically improves the connectivity that can be achieved through signals, giving them the flexibility to:
- set properties that doesn't have a setter by connecting to "set"
- set nested properties like position:x and shape:radius by connecting to "set_indexed"
- makes it clearer what the final arguments of a new signal will be by adding default args to the connection viewer
answers.workaround:
It would allow native connectivity between signals and properties.

Working around this with script would require doubling the signal count and adding a new "Remapper" node for each signal that takes a bound remap argument.
